shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab
horizontal register bands dividing the surface
repeated row of similar small motifs along the top
justification: Both are upright slabs carved in low relief with figures organised into horizontal registers, including a row of repeated small motifs across the upper zone and animal and anthropomorphic forms below. But the specific content differs entirely: A shows seated and standing human figures in profile with headdresses, offerings and rows of script-like signs, while B shows quadrupeds/birds and a hunched crouching creature with no human worshippers, no offerings and no writing; the styles (fine detailed profile human bodies vs blocky schematic beasts) share no conventions.
